files.description: hft3 mandatory ontology, Fable, workflow, and verification contract.
hft3 GrepLoop contract: local rg is preflight only; PR GrepLoop requires Greptile review evidence.
AI coding delegate safety contract and non-production boundaries.
Required dual-pass reviewer contract for hft3 changes.

rules.rule: Do not accept claims that local rg/preflight, CodeRabbit, Cursor Bugbot, or generic CI checks satisfy PR GrepLoop; only Greptile review evidence can satisfy that gate.
The coding delegate must never persist or exfiltrate secrets, must not apply patches automatically, and must keep draft output inside ignored runtime/ai_delegate quarantine.
For HFT3 finance/math/research behavior, reject uncited methodology, invented pipelines, stale replay-universe paths, and claims that bypass VectorBT/HftBacktest source-lock constraints.
